ns2:course.label: Data Analytics for Management Accounting
ns2:course.description: Data analytics incorporated into management decision making, including planning, cost management, and management control system design. Focuses on developing your skills of gathering and analyzing data for internal decision making purposes. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Enrollment in graduate accounting degree program or consent of department.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Enrollment in graduate accounting degree program or consent of department.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BS:Accountancy -UIUC, BS: Business Multi Majors-UIUC, MAS:Accountancy -UIUC, or MS: Accy - Cost Rec -UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionCappArea: Restricted to BS/MS Accy 3+2 Pgm students.
